tree.heading: Federal agency head
tree.text: The term “Federal agency head” means the head of any executive, legislative, or judicial branch Government entity that employs Federal law enforcement officers.

tree.heading: Federal Board
tree.text: The term “Federal Board” means the Federal Law Enforcement Congressional Badge of Bravery Board established under section 50313(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Federal Board members
tree.text: The term “Federal Board members” means the members of the Federal Board appointed under section 50313(c) of this title.

tree.heading: Federal Law Enforcement Badge
tree.text: The term “Federal Law Enforcement Badge” means the Federal Law Enforcement Congressional Badge of Bravery described in section 50311 of this title.

tree.heading: Office
tree.text: The term “Office” means the Congressional Badge of Bravery Office established under section 50331(a) of this title.

tree.heading: State and Local Board
tree.text: The term “State and Local Board” means the State and Local Law Enforcement Congressional Badge of Bravery Board established under section 50323(a) of this title.

tree.heading: State and Local Board members
tree.text: The term “State and Local Board members” means the members of the State and Local Board appointed under section 50323(c) of this title.

tree.heading: State and Local Law Enforcement Badge
tree.text: The term “State and Local Law Enforcement Badge” means the State and Local Law Enforcement Congressional Badge of Bravery described in section 50321 of this title.

tree.heading: State or local agency head
tree.text: The term “State or local agency head” means the head of any executive, legislative, or judicial branch entity of a State or local government that employs State or local law enforcement officers.

tree.heading: State or local law enforcement officer
tree.text: The term “State or local law enforcement officer” means an employee of a State or local government—

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 15231 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: For short title of Pub. L. 110–298, which is classified to this chapter, as the “Law Enforcement Congressional Badge of Bravery Act of 2008”, see section 1 of Pub. L. 110–298, set out as a Short Title of 2008 Act note under section 10101 of this title.
